A '''[[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone navigation officer]]''' was stationed aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']], shortly prior to the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The naval officer decrypted an audio message from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] with [[Dooku/Legends|Count Dooku's]] [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], talking about preparations for the upcoming war.
